translation: Also, the wooden ring in the bull's nose (牛鼻中木卷) treats children's epilepsy (小兒癇). Grass-ring (草卷) burned to ash treats children's sores below the nose (小兒鼻下瘡). The original text of the Benjing: Niujiao [blank] (牛角) sends down closed blood and stagnant blood and pain (閉血瘀血疼痛), and women's discharge of blood with dai (帶下血).
